# YAML Map

Prefer the Agent Workspace MCP `yaml_map_*` tools when they are available in
the active agent client. Use `tool_search` to discover them if they are not
already visible. The CLI implementation at `agent_tools/tools/yaml_map` is the
fallback path when MCP tools are unavailable or when a workflow needs shell
composition. Do not depend on a globally installed the agent skill for this
workflow.

Use this skill for structured YAML work where preserving valid YAML and editing
the intended path matters more than raw text replacement.

## Core Workflow

With MCP, use workspace-relative file paths through `yaml_map_file`,
`yaml_map_project`, `yaml_map_path_get`, `yaml_map_path_set`,
`yaml_map_item_insert`, `yaml_map_path_delete`, and
`yaml_map_parse_check`.

For CLI fallback, run commands from the workspace root or another directory
where `agent_tools` is importable:

```sh
python -m agent_tools.tools.yaml_map <command> ...
```

Inspect a YAML file before editing:

```sh
python -m agent_tools.tools.yaml_map map path/to/file.yml
```

For broader discovery, inspect a project:

```sh
python -m agent_tools.tools.yaml_map project-map path/to/project --deep
```

Read a specific path before changing it:

```sh
python -m agent_tools.tools.yaml_map path-get path/to/file.yml \
  --path build.settings
```

## Guarded Edits

Use the hash from `map` or `path-get` for guarded path updates:

```sh
python -m agent_tools.tools.yaml_map path-set path/to/file.yml \
  --path build.settings.board_root \
  --expect-hash <hash> \
  --value-json '".'"
```

Insert list or mapping items with `item-insert`:

```sh
python -m agent_tools.tools.yaml_map item-insert path/to/file.yml \
  --path jobs.build.steps \
  --index 0 \
  --expect-hash <hash> \
  --value-file /tmp/step.json
```

Use `--check-only` first for risky edits.

## Validation

After every YAML edit, run:

```sh
python -m agent_tools.tools.yaml_map parse-check path/to/file.yml
```

If a YAML format relies on comments or unusual formatting that the structured
tool cannot preserve, report that limitation and use the narrowest manual edit.
